argument: The membrane must read as one continuous skin before it reads as 31 slices. The cut, strata, and stain must be actual geometry, not a meter or a set of local marks.

With labels, readout, controls, hint, and furniture hidden, the first field must read as a vertical painted membrane with stored directional tension, not a pool field, plate array, ribbon, line chart, or generic scroll interface. After reversal, the void and shear must be findable in the skin.

One, two, and three same-direction ticks must remain geometry-neutral. Only an opposite tick after the three-tick load may commit; the cursor location must not choose the scar. Arrow keys, wheel, swipe, Enter, and the reversal control must share the causal rule; Delete must restore the exact preceding membrane.

The reversal ledger must feed later membrane geometry. Four events remain bounded and liftable; release returns to the quiet seed, while lifting reconstructs the exact preceding skin rather than clearing a counter.

p5.brush is translated from programmable pressure, density, and directional fields into a reversal-only material law. The source's brush, watercolor, hatching, grain, palette, composition, code, and API vocabulary are refused.

v035 leaves v034's proximity census, v033's three-knock laminate, and v031's drag refusal through a monolithic vertical membrane, a scroll/arrow reversal encounter, and a temporal tension model in which reversal—not contact—changes the material.

Delete v035 if same-direction loading changes geometry, if the work is merely a chart with scroll controls, if reversal changes only colour or readout, if the cursor location selects the void, if later reversals forget, or if exact lifting fails.
